# AtlasAR — 3D Model Viewer, Augmented Reality & Virtual Try-On for WordPress

> AtlasAR is a WordPress and WooCommerce plugin that displays interactive 3D product models and lets shoppers place them in their own space with augmented reality on iOS and Android. It also includes AtlasTryOn, a webcam-based virtual try-on for glasses and caps. Free version on WordPress.org; AtlasAR Pro from $49.99/year. Built by AtlasAiDev.

Last updated: 2026-07-31
Site: https://wpaugmentedreality.com

## Products on this site

- [AtlasAR — 3D Model Viewer & Augmented Reality](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/): Rotate, zoom and pan 3D models on any product page using Google's `<model-viewer>` engine, with mobile AR floor and wall placement via Scene Viewer (Android) and AR Quick Look (iOS). Supports `.glb`, `.gltf` and `.usdz`. Native WooCommerce integration with automatic "View in AR" buttons, shortcode and Gutenberg block support.
- [AtlasTryOn — Virtual Try-On for glasses and caps](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/docs/virtual-try-on-glasses-caps/get-started/virtual-try-on-glasses-caps/): Webcam-based try-on. Privacy by design — the camera feed stays on the shopper's device and is never uploaded.

## Try it

- [Live AR demo shop](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/shop/): Working WooCommerce store demonstrating 3D viewing, AR placement and try-on.
- [Free version on WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/plugins/ar-vr-3d-model-try-on/): Slug `ar-vr-3d-model-try-on`.

## Pricing

Full detail: [pricing.md](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/pricing.md) · Live page: [/pricing/](https://wpaugmentedreality.com/pricing/)

- **Free** — $0. Unlimited model uploads with no caps on file count or size, 3D viewer, WooCommerce integration, mobile AR, AtlasTryOn webcam try-on, AI 3D model generation.
- **AtlasAR Pro** — $49.99/year (1 site), $99.99/year (5 sites), $149.99/year (10 sites). Lifetime: $149.99, $249.99, $399.99. 14-day money-back guarantee.

## Technical facts

- WordPress.org plugin title: "3D Viewer – 3D Model Viewer – Augmented Reality – Virtual Try On"
- Slug: `ar-vr-3d-model-try-on`
- Requires WordPress 5.6+ and PHP 7.4+; tested to WordPress 7.0.2
- 3D formats: `.glb`, `.gltf` (Android / web 3D), `.usdz` (iOS AR Quick Look)
- 3D engine: Google `<model-viewer>`
- AR: Scene Viewer (Android), AR Quick Look (iOS) — floor and wall placement
- AI 3D model generation (text-to-model) via Tripo3D or Meshy AI
- Pro adds: server-side compression, interactive hotspots, dimensions display, configurators, slider / multiple-model display, QR code generation, priority email support

## Company

AtlasAR and AtlasTryOn are built by **AtlasAiDev**. This site is the dedicated home for the AR products; it is not a separate company.
